name: Camp Newhoca and Center 375 Summer Day Camp
description_short: Vernon's town summer day camp, run at two sites: Camp Newhoca on Grier Road, which swims in a roped off area of Middle Bolton Lake, and Center 375 on Hartford Turnpike, which uses the community pool. Camp runs 8 am to 3 pm with an extended program to 6 pm, and is mostly outdoors with games, crafts, sports and swimming.
special_needs_notes: Campers with special needs are placed in integrated groups when the child can be served safely; request a meeting in writing at least four weeks before the first day.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp Newhoca swims in a roped off area of Middle Bolton Lake; Center 375 uses the municipal community pool. Lifeguards test each camper; no flotation devices.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer 2026 handbook (updated February 2026). Camp Newhoca, 195 Grier Road, and Center 375 Camp, 375 Hartford Turnpike, both Monday to Friday 8 am to 3 pm with an Extended PM Program 3 to 6 pm. Teen Camp (Tuesday to Thursday) and CIT are separate. Campers bring a non refrigerated lunch. Municipal camp, exempt from state licensing. The handbook gives no ages, dates or fees.
